summary.text: Justin Filip is the Pacific Green Party and Progressive Party nominee for Oregon's 4th Congressional District. A University of Oregon graduate who worked as a program coordinator at the university, he has held party leadership roles in the Pacific Green Party since 2021. This is his second run for the seat; according to his campaign, his priorities include reducing military spending, addressing homelessness and protecting federal lands.

paragraphs.text: Justin Filip was born in Michigan, moved to Oregon in 1995, and earned a bachelor's degree in psychology from the University of Oregon.
In 2024 he described himself as a Program Coordinator at the University of Oregon, and according to his campaign site he co-founded the UO Faculty and Staff for Justice in Palestine in April 2024.
Filip served on the Pacific Green Party's State Coordinating Committee from 2021 to 2024 and is the party's secretary and co-chair of its Eugene chapter.
Filip first ran for office in 2024 as the Pacific Green candidate in the 4th District, receiving 10,315 votes (2.7%) against Val Hoyle's 195,862.

Other roles listed on Ballotpedia include cultural development chair of the Buena Vista Parent Organization and a seat on the Eugene Figure Skating Club board, and he has volunteered with the Egan Warming Centers and as a youth baseball coach.
